title: Mapping the neuronal building blocks of human language with language models
goal: Reproduce the original sentence-held-out supplied-embedding-to-neuron predictivity result across the registered sessions, units, temporal lags and layers, preserving original population and individual-unit outputs and lexical, shuffle and context controls. Evaluate improvement on the same prediction support and source-defined reduction after its complete comparison is qualified. Figure 3b is a numerical anchor, not a substitute for the complete intended outputs.
